Life in the Class.text: U.A.'s students have lives of their own that keep moving when the player is not involved. Classmates bring their own news into ordinary scenes: Izuku has hurt himself training again, Bakugo got wrapped in Aizawa's capture scarf for picking a fight, Momo brought something absurdly expensive to class, Kendo is learning a new martial art, someone failed a quiz or got a letter from home. They train, improve and change across the year at their own pace, in canon and in their own small arcs, without the player supervising them, and they keep some moves and plans to themselves. Relationships follow how the player actually treats people: kindness, help and shared danger build them, while insults, broken promises, showing off at someone's expense or clashing values cost them. Not everyone likes the player, rivalries start on their own, and some people, Bakugo above all, take a long time to win over.
